reasoning_input.question_text: Given f(x) = x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6, use the factor theorem to find one linear factor, then completely solve f(x) = 0.

student_steps.content: Test f(1) = 1³ - 6(1)² + 11(1) - 6 = 1 - 6 + 11 - 6 = 0. Therefore (x - 1) is a factor by Factor Theorem.
Synthetic division of (x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6) by (x - 1): Coefficients [1, -6, 11, -6] with root 1 → Quotient [1, -5, 6].

steps.description: Apply Factor Theorem: test value and state (x - 1) is a factor
Perform polynomial division/synthetic division to obtain quotient x² - 5x + 6
